_note: Nov 15 (Aaron: 'the little text that pops up on the screen showing what you picked up is gone before you can read it'): pickups worth an inspect card (ui/InspectCard.js), one button ('got it'). Not lore: nothing here is handed in. Same card fields as lore.json. Every line a draft.

card.label: #c8b070
card.line: A brass tag on the ring, numbers stamped in it: the combination to his safe.

card.label: #5a5e62
card.line: A bolt-action with a proper scope. Hits hard, reloads slow. It's empty: Earl never found the right rounds.
card.linePad: A bolt-action with a proper scope. Hits hard, reloads slow. It's empty: Earl never found the right rounds. RB flicks through your guns; D-pad down picks which ones are in the rotation, so an empty one never gets in the way.
card.lineKeys: A bolt-action with a proper scope. Hits hard, reloads slow. It's empty: Earl never found the right rounds. The mouse wheel flicks through your guns; G picks which ones are in the rotation, so an empty one never gets in the way.

card.label: #7ae0e8
card.line: A small power cell, warm and humming. The pilot's sidearm. Alien shells (hold B to choose them). An alien med kit.

card.label: #4a4e52
card.line: Off the pegs in the Pruitts' kitchen, a box of shells beside it. Up close, nothing stays standing.

card.label: #c8b070
card.line: A box of rounds that fit Earl's hunting rifle, on the shelf in the comms hut.

items.name: An explosive charge, with its detonator

card.label: #c04030
card.line: Army issue, from the comms hut. Set it, walk away, press the button. Save it for something big.

card.label: #c8a060
card.line: A handful of toy cowboys, the kind that come fifty to a bag, lined up along the shelf. Each one has been measured: tiny marks scratched along its base.

card.label: #e0d090
card.line: A toy sheriff's badge, its pin bent. Someone has polished it. It sits on a little stand of its own, as if it matters.

card.label: #7a8a5a
card.line: Earl's: his initials scratched in the case, the strap cut clean. The last picture on its little screen is the quad, parked where Tom left it, and a long grey hand on the handlebar.
